run_segmentation_evaluation: run semantic segmentation evaluation on a dataset using a trained encoder-decoder model with argparse CLI
run_surface_normals_evaluation: run surface normals evaluation on NYUv2 dataset using the segmentation module and normals evaluator
run_visualization: run evaluation with visualization enabled to save side-by-side ground truth and prediction images
run_multiscale_inference: run multiscale inference by passing multiple image sizes via the imgSize argument for averaged predictions
run_main_entry: run the main evaluation script with required dirname, dataset, split_name, and image_mode arguments
